Is your jaw stiff? Do you have trouble opening all the way? Maybe when you yawn or attempt to eat a large piece of food you can’t quite open wide or it really hurts when you do? Well, most people automatically assume it’s the muscle and therefore they need to massage it. But very very commonly when there is stiffness, it’s a joint issue NOT a muscle issue. A muscle issue will feel achy and painful and like there’s an uncomfortable light stretch occurring when moving but rarely does it result an actual stiffness or limited motion. Therefore, if your solution to jaw stiffness is massaging the muscle, you’ll be in a cycle of temporary relief and regression back to stifness. In this video, I demonstrate to strategies that can be completed to start mobilizing the joint capsule of the TMJ itself to start actually relieving the root cause of stiffness. #tmj #tmjdisorder #tmd #jawpainrelief

Family day trip with identical twin boys 👦🏼👦🏼 Leaving the house with kids is probably one of the hardest things to do.  As new parents, it’s easy to get sucked into the kids routines and never really get out of the house with them. We make it a goal to get out of the house and force the boys to be flexible with their schedules.  Naps out of the house aren’t always going to go to plan. Learning to be comfortable and calm in uncomfortable situations is important. When either or both of the boys have a meltdown in public we sometimes feel like every person is looking or judging us. Parents deserve to have lives too and it’s unrealistic to think kids won’t cry out in public. It’s going to happen so you might as well embrace it.  In the end, parents are trying their best to figure out how to live their own lives while trying to give their kids the best life possible. So next time you’re in public and you see/hear a crying baby, instead of rolling your eyes and judging… have a little sympathy for the parent who is just trying their best.  This trip out with the boys was so much fun! Until we got stuck in traffic on the way home and the boys absolutely lost it 😅. #twins #twinboys #identicaltwins #twinlife #dadlife #parenting #reels #identicaltwinboys

After work routine with identical twin boys 👦🏼👦🏼  Like most people, my wife and I both have jobs and can’t always have our schedules work to where one of us is always home. Thankfully, we have help from family when Jordan and I both work on the same day.  Coming home from work and going straight into parent mode is not a fun/easy task. Usually, once I get off of work I just want to zone out and decompress for a while. That is not possible when you’re coming home to two boys who are ready for bed.  My wife works longer days than I do, so I always make sure to have the house cleaned up for when she gets home.  Everything we do is for the benefit of our family and we’re so lucky that we get to spend so much time with our boys 👦🏼👦🏼🐶🐶. #twins #twin #twinlife #identicaltwins #identicaltwinboys #reels #dadlife #parenting

Comment the word ‘JAW’ on this video if you need help fixing jaw or facial pain. Trigeminal Neuralgia is a very popular term or diagnosis nowadays.  Too common. I am finding it more and more commonly used as a grab bag sort of term.  Have jaw or facial pain? Then it must be trigeminal neuralgia! NOT. True trigeminal neuralgia is a dysfunction of the nerve itself or commonly due to compression from a blood vessel. It is also characteristically extremely painful, comes in intense waves causing severe anxiety and depression.  Described as the worst pain imaginableable!  Does that sound like you? Or can you better relate to uncomfortable pain near the eye nose or jaw? This is what most people experience. The trigeminal nerve carries signals to the jaw teeth gums and skin of side of face nasal, forehead and eye areas… so yeah a lot can activate pain in this area of distribution. In this video I explore 3 possible explanations for this type of pain.  I also show assessments and treatment options.  If you notice a positive test or any type of change from the given treatments… then there is a good chance you don’t have ‘trigeminal neuralgia’ but instead another mechanical dysfunction!!! #tmj #tmd #trigeminalneuralgia #dentist #toothache #migrainerelief #neckpain

Do you experience tension in the front of your throat? Difficulty swallowing, TMJ disorder, jaw pain or even neck tension when you look up? Well very commonly the muscles around the front of the neck, jaw and floor of the mouth can become tight…. Including the Sternohyoid! You see the infrahyoid muscles (below hyoid bone) one of which being the sternohyoid stabilize the hyoid bone… in other words they prevent the hyoid from elevating during swallowing. This allows the suprahyoids, which are above the hyoid bone to open the jaw.  Confused yet? However, when the infrahyoids, specifically that sternohyoid become too tight, they can create all sorts of discomfort. In this video, I show an excellent way to release the Sternohyoid. 👋🏾What’s up BBQ family?! Smoking oxtails is a two-step process that infuses them with rich, smoky flavor before braising them until melt-in-your-mouth tender. Here's a general guide: Preparation: ✅Trim the oxtails:  Remove excess fat from the outside of each piece. You can ask your butcher to do this for you at the time of purchase. ✅Seasoning: Season generously with your favorite BBQ rub or a combination of salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 🪵Smoking: Prepare your smoker for indirect cooking at a temperature between 250-275°F (121-135°C). You can use wood chips like pecan, hickory, or oak for added smokiness. 🔥Smoke the oxtails: Place the seasoned oxtails on the smoker rack and smoke for 2-3 hours, flipping them occasionally, until they develop a deep mahogany color and start to get tender. Braising: ✅Braising liquid: Prepare a braising liquid with beef broth, red wine, herbs, and vegetables (optional) in a large pot or Dutch oven. ✅Transfer oxtails: Transfer the smoked oxtails to the braising liquid, ensuring they are submerged. 😋Braise until tender: Cover the pot and braise the oxtails in your oven or on the stovetop at low heat for 2-4 hours, or until the meat is very tender and falling off the bone. Tips: You can sear the oxtails in a hot pan with oil before smoking for an extra layer of flavor. Basting the oxtails occasionally with the braising liquid during smoking adds moisture and keeps them from drying out. Once the oxtails are braised, you can skim the fat from the surface of the braising liquid and reduce it to make a thicker sauce for serving. This tiny camera can literally fit in the palm of your hand — this is the Minolta 110 Zoom SLR Mark II, and it’s certainly one of the cutest cameras we have tested recently.  Beyond its tiny size, this camera is one of the most sophisticated ways to shoot 110 film, with full manual control of aperture, focus, and zoom, and a stepless automatic shutter with speeds to 1/1000th.  In its day, the Minolta 110 Zoom SLR Mark II was an expensive purchase — the camera listed for $342 in 1979, or over $1500 adjusted for inflation. Luckily, these cameras are much more affordable today on the used market, usually trading around $100.  And 110 film is still available — we sell fresh Lomography stock in both color and black and white. Today we’ll load with a roll of LOMO Color ’92. This camera is a breeze to shoot, with LEDs in the viewfinder for the light meter.  We did find that the f3.5 aperture was limiting in low light even with this 400 speed film, so we mounted this Minolta Auto 128 flash, which is about as big as the camera itself.  The Minolta 25-67mm Zoom Rokkor lens is known to be one of the sharpest 110 optics, but is limited by the image quality of 110 film itself, which has about 1/4 of the surface area of 35mm.  Still, we think these cameras are great fun to shoot — we develop, scan, and print from 110 film!  #minolta #minolta110zoomslr #minolta110zoomslrmarkii #110film #lomography #color92 #lomocolor92  #film #analog #filmcamera #shootfilm #kodak #filmcommunity #ishootfilm #vintage #analog #classic #1970s #1980s #portland

"Olá pessoal, eu estou aqui no Castelo de #akershus - em Oslo - #Noruega, e o melhor de tudo, este castelo é aberto à visitação, então se você estiver na cidade, não deixe de conferir!"  No centro da praça principal do Castelo, há uma estátua de um #leão  segurando um escudo com as armas da Noruega. Essa estátua é conhecida como o "Leão de Akershus" e simboliza a força e a bravura dos #soldados que defenderam o castelo ao longo dos #séculos  O #escudo exibe as #armas  da Noruega, destacando a importância do castelo como uma #fortaleza  nacional e como um símbolo da soberania norueguesa. Este castelo tem mais de 700 anos e é um dos monumentos mais importantes da Noruega.  Dê uma olhada nesta vista incrível do Fiorde de Oslo! Isso é uma visão que os antigos guerreiros noruegueses tinham quando estavam defendendo suas terras. Aqui estão alguns dos #canhões  que foram usados para proteger a fortaleza ao longo dos anos. Eles foram fabricados em diferentes épocas e são tão fascinantes quanto assustadores! Este é o #coração  do castelo, a fortaleza original, onde os #governantes  noruegueses costumavam viver. Olhando do alto do castelo, você pode ver a cidade toda. Inesquecível! O Castelo de Akershus, que fica em Oslo, na Noruega, tem entrada #gratuita  para sua área externa e para algumas partes internas do castelo. No entanto, há uma taxa de entrada para visitar algumas das áreas internas do castelo, como as exposições e o museu.  O valor da entrada pode variar dependendo da época do ano e das exposições disponíveis. É importante verificar o site oficial do Castelo de Akershus para obter as informações mais atualizadas sobre horários, preços e a disponibilidade das visitas guiadas. #viagemcultural #castle #castles #patrimôniohistórico  #curiosidadeshistóricas  #arquiteturaantiga  #turismocultural #osloturisme
